But rather than locking in a durable agreement, the extension appears to push the central questions — tariffs, Chinese purchases, rare-earth supplies and technology restrictions — into the next round of negotiations. Bessent said on Wednesday that Beijing was meeting its requirement in the earlier agreement to buy 25 million tons of soybeans but was lagging on its pledge to buy US$17 billion in other agricultural goods. US officials have said rare-earth deliveries were also falling short, another sign that significant gaps remain. For companies, the result is a familiar form of instability: tariff rates remain lower for now, but decisions must still be made against a shifting policy backdrop.

Related:

Trump praises US-China friendship, talks up White House ballroom during state dinner for China's Xi

Trump-Xi summit in Washington begins with great fanfare but low expectations

DRESS TO IMPRESS For Trump , Xi 's White House visit was an opportunity to show off a Washington being remade in his image. After Xi treated Trump in Beijing to a tour around a Ming dynasty temple and a walled-off garden retreat rarely opened to foreigners, the US president returned the favor with a different kind of spectacle: Troops wearing wigs and tri-corner hats marched in formation and played music in a Rose Garden redesigned to look like a Trump golf club. Fighter jets and bombers roared overhead during ceremonies staged on Wednesday and Thursday, one so loud it caused Trump to flinch. When the White House press corps was called to cover the two leaders, it wasn’t to hear them talk about the weighty affairs of state. Instead, it was to watch them tour the Marine One helicopter and the recently redesigned South Lawn of the White House, replete with a large helipad emblazoned with the presidential seal. Speaking to reporters, Trump brushed away questions about their policy discussions. “He loves good granite,” Trump said of Xi . “Great meeting.” XI WANTS US "PRUDENCE" OVER TAIWAN As expected, Xi pressed Trump on the Taiwan issue, saying, according to China's official news agency, that China hoped the United States would "handle the Taiwan question with prudence. " The agency's English-language service also wrote that Xi hoped the US would oppose Taiwan independence. That would be a tougher version of Washington's long-standing formulation that it does not "support" independence. There are no signs that the Trump administration plans to change its wording. There was no immediate White House readout of the exchange, but US officials have long avoided explicitly stating opposition to Taiwanese independence. Any shift in language would raise questions about Washington's resolve to defend the island and provoke opposition in Congress.

Related:

Trump-Xi summit: Xi Jinping calls for US and China to be partners rather than rivals

Trump’s high-level welcome for Xi puts personal diplomacy in focus, analysts say

STRATEGIC RISK Xi , not for the first time while meeting Trump , invoked the "Thucydides Trap", an academic theory that competition between a rising power and an established one tends toward war. While the Chinese leader said the risk "can be overcome," his reference underscored how concerns about a potential US-China military conflict continue to shadow relations between the world's two largest powers. Xi argued that both nations stand to gain from cooperation and lose from confrontation, and he called for regular military dialogue and stronger crisis-prevention mechanisms. Trump , for his part, drew on the two nations' shared history to emphasize the potential for cooperation. They could accomplish much by pursuing common interests, he said, invoking their wartime alliance against Japan. DIFFERENCES ON AI The two leaders expressed diverging views about artificial intelligence. Trump, who has declared that AI should be called super intelligence, or SI, said in a social media post that he wants “to leave it exactly where it is" and rely on the US Department of Justice rather than impose any new guardrails. He insisted that China held the same position. But Xi said on Thursday that, as leading nations on AI, China and the US must manage its growth. “We have both the capability and responsibility to develop and manage AI for good, and ensure that the development of AI is always under human control and serves the well-being of the people,” Xi said. Some of the biggest names in AI were expected to attend Trump's state dinner at the White House on Thursday for Xi, including Alphabet's Sundar Pichai, OpenAI's Sam Altman and Nvidia's Jensen Huang.

Related:

Snap Insight: Though Trump-Xi summit achieves little, 2026 is a high point in US-China relations

Source: Reuters/bg

item.title: 日本市場、米債売り加速で金利一段高へ－円は軟調公算・AI株上値重い
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 　　25日の日本市場では、原油高や財政懸念を背景に米国債売りが加速したことを受け、国債利回りが一段と上昇しそう。金利のボラティリティーの高さから投資家のリスクセンチメントが悪化し、株式はAI関連を中心に上値の重い展開が予想される。為替は米金利高を手がかりとしたドル買いが優勢で、円は160円の節目に向けて軟調に推移しそうだ。

米国とイランの交渉担当者はホルムズ海峡の再開に向けて段階的な合意を模索しているものの、通航再開に対する懐疑的な見方は根強く、24日の原油先物相場は急伸した。原油価格の高止まりによるインフレ懸念が利上げ観測を高め、世界的な債券売りが広がっている。

米30年債利回りは一時2004年以来の高水準となり、日本でも債券売りが強まりそうだ。金融引き締めへの観測に加え、日本の財政懸念も引き続き重しとなる。きょうは残存期間5年超11年以下を対象とした流動性供給入札が実施される。

金利の大幅変動が投資家のリスク選好に逆風となり、株式市場で積極的な取引は控えられやすい。米フィラデルフィア半導体株指数（SOX）が下落しており、国内でも前日に買われたAI・半導体関連株を中心に売りが先行しそうだ。

為替はドルが強含む中、円は24日に一時159円04銭と2日以来の安値に下げた。160円の節目が意識される半面、160円に接近すれば当局による介入への警戒が一段と高まるとみられ、一方的な円売りには歯止めがかかる可能性が高い。

（注：表中の終値は米国時間終値。円相場は対米ドル、前営業日比は円の対ドル変化率。米10年金利の前営業日比は変化幅（単位：%ポイント）。日経平均の前営業日比はシカゴ・マーカンタイル取引所清算値と大阪取引所清算値との比較。シカゴ取引所が休場の場合は大阪取引所の夜間終値と通常取引清算値の比較。金は1トロイオンス当たりのドル建て価格）

item.title: 原油下落、イランがホルムズ再開巡る新提案を米国に提出とFT報道
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 原油相場はアジア時間25日の取引で下落。米国とイランの交渉担当者が、イランによるホルムズ海峡の再開につながる段階的な合意を模索していると伝わった。

北海ブレント先物は1バレル＝106ドルを下回った。過去2営業日で7%余り上昇していた。米ウェスト・テキサス・インターミディエート（WTI）は93ドル近辺。協議に詳しい関係者によると、ここ数カ月は同様の合意に至っていない米・イラン双方が、国連総会に合わせて打開を目指しているという。

英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（FT）によると、イランのアラグチ外相はニューヨークで記者団に対し、一定の条件が満たされればホルムズ海峡の通航を7日以内に再開する新たな提案を米国側に提出したと明らかにした。

両国の衝突が7カ月近く続く中、原油相場は今週も不安定な値動きとなった。戦争の先行きを巡るまちまちなシグナルや、中東からの原油輸送が持ち直す兆し、米国がディーゼル輸出を禁止するとの観測に振り回されている。北海ブレントは年初来でなお70%以上上昇しており、インフレ圧力を強めている。

カロバール・キャピタルのハリス・クルシド最高投資責任者（CIO）は「状況に大きな変化がなければ、ブレントは100－110ドル近辺で推移するだろう」と指摘。「信頼できる段階的な合意が成立すれば、比較的早く100ドルを下回る可能性がある。一方、輸出や物流網で再び障害が起きれば120ドルも視野に入る」と述べた。

ペルシャ湾と世界市場を結ぶ狭い航路であるホルムズ海峡は、戦争の焦点となってきた。イランは同海峡に対する主権的な管理権を持つと主張。平時には世界の原油と天然ガス供給の約5分の1が同海峡を通過していた。一方、米国は同海峡の現状を変更してはならないと主張しつつ、イランの港湾を封鎖している。

ホワイトハウス当局者は、トランプ米大統領が引き続きイランとの協議に前向きだと説明。ただ、制裁措置と海上封鎖によって米国は強い立場にあり、交渉する必要はないとも強調した。トランプ氏は2月末、イランの核開発計画を終わらせるとの目的を掲げ、イスラエルと共同で攻撃に踏み切った。

item.description:
（ブルームバーグ）： ホワイトハウスは裁判所への提出書類で、トランプ米大統領が先週出入りを禁止した報道機関3社について、当面の立ち入りを再び認めたと明らかにした。
CNN、MS NOW、ポリティコの3社は、連邦裁判所が出入り禁止措置の差し止めを命じた後、記者が再び立ち入りを認められたと明らかにした。これに先立ち3社は、判事の命令にもかかわらず、記者がホワイトハウスの敷地への立ち入りを拒否されたとしていた。
CNNとMS
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： ホワイトハウスは裁判所への提出書類で、トランプ米大統領が先週出入りを禁止した報道機関3社について、当面の立ち入りを再び認めたと明らかにした。

CNN、MS NOW、ポリティコの3社は、連邦裁判所が出入り禁止措置の差し止めを命じた後、記者が再び立ち入りを認められたと明らかにした。これに先立ち3社は、判事の命令にもかかわらず、記者がホワイトハウスの敷地への立ち入りを拒否されたとしていた。

CNNとMS NOWは24日の放送で、立ち入りが認められたことを明らかにした。

ホワイトハウスのストッペリッチ報道運営局長は、政権が24日早朝、対象となった記者の立ち入りを再び認める手続きに着手したと説明した。立ち入りを再び認めるよう命じる裁判所命令は夜間に出され、ストッペリッチ氏によると、米東部時間午前9時55分までに記者証を受け取れる状態になった。

これに先立ち、ティモシー・J・ケリー米連邦地裁判事は、立ち入りを認めるよう命じたにもかかわらず入れないとの報道各社からの申し立てについて、ホワイトハウスに回答を求めていた。

ケリー判事は夜間に出した命令で、報道各社が起こした訴訟の審理が続く間、ホワイトハウスへの立ち入りを一時的に再び許可するよう命じた。命令は2週間有効となる。判事は、10月5日までに追加の裁判書類を受け取った後、記者の立ち入りを延長するかどうかを検討するため、改めて審理の日程を設定するとした。

トランプ氏は9月18日、政権に不利な報道を行っているとして、3社のホワイトハウスへの立ち入りを禁止すると発表した。その4日後に3社へ送付した正式な書簡で、政権は、政権に関する報道に伴う国家安全保障上の懸念に基づく決定だと説明した。

裁判所に提出された同書簡では、匿名の情報源に依拠したとみられる報道や、イランや国際的な制裁、共和党大会などの問題について、政権内部の協議や当局者が取った行動に関する情報を明らかにした報道が複数取り上げられていた。

item.title: Law firms vie for tech talent in AI race
item.description: (Billable Hours is Reuters' weekly report on lawyers and money. Please send tips or suggestions to D.Thomas@thomsonreuters.com)
item.dc:creator: Sara Merken
item.content:encoded: (Billable Hours is Reuters' weekly report on lawyers and money. Please send tips or suggestions to D.Thomas@thomsonreuters.com ) As major companies and startups compete to hire engineers and data scientists to fuel the AI boom, David Wang is hoping to lure technologists to his law firm instead. Cooley, where Wang serves as chief innovation officer, is hiring for more than a dozen high-tech positions amid an escalating AI push at big law firms. The Palo Alto-based firm this month unveiled a new subsidiary it describes as a “firm-owned artificial intelligence company,” Cooley AI, to build internal tools for its lawyers and reshape how it delivers legal services. Wang said Cooley AI will be managed like a startup but integrated with the law firm's decision-making, a mix he said could appeal to AI and other experts who want a job that lets them apply their work directly to legal challenges. "You want people that want to work on really frontier difficult problems, and that is something that is hard for a law firm to promise," he said. The pitch to technical and legal talent is that Cooley AI is the "best of both worlds," Wang said, connecting hires with the law firm's business while offering meaningful work on cutting-edge AI issues. The launch of Cooley AI coincided with the firm's September 17 announcement of a product developed with OpenAI to help companies go public, for use by the firm’s attorneys in client work. It was timed with OpenAI's [USN:L6N45917D TEXT:"release"] of a legal industry-focused version of its latest AI technology, GPT-6 Astra, that it said is designed to help law firms and legal software providers conduct research, draft advice and build custom applications for lawyers. OpenAI said it has also been working with other big law firms on new tools, including Ropes & Gray and Sullivan & Cromwell. Law firms across the board are hiring technologists and strategists to staff AI and technology teams. Covington & Burling; Cravath, Swaine & Moore; Latham & Watkins; Kirkland & Ellis; McGuireWoods; Mayer Brown and White & Case are among those that are currently advertising AI-related job roles on LinkedIn. Salaries range per position, with one firm offering up to $438,000 for a director of applied AI. Cooley, known for its work advising technology and life sciences companies, is currently hiring for 14 roles within Cooley AI, including for senior engineers. At least four hires have already joined, including from other law firms, according to LinkedIn posts. Wang said Cooley AI just hired an engineer from Adobe and that other hires are in the works from large technology companies and startups. He declined to comment on compensation for new hires but said that "the market price is the market price. We're planning to be competitive." The firm's advertised salary ranges on LinkedIn included $220,000 to $250,000 for a senior AI data engineer. That pay would be roughly commensurate to a first-year lawyer's salary at Cooley and other large firms. The race among law firms to incorporate AI has led some firms to publicize their spending on the technology. Kirkland & Ellis in May said it plans to [USN:L6N4251D3 TEXT:"devote $500 million"] of its revenue to developing a custom AI platform over the next three to four years. Personal injury firm Morgan & Morgan has [USN:L6N4560UK TEXT:"committed at least $1 billion"] over the next decade, the firm said this month. Cooley declined to comment about the scale of its investment in Cooley AI. Some law firms, meanwhile, are losing lawyers to AI companies. Forty-six lawyers from the top 200 highest-grossing firms in the United States in the first half of 2026 moved to companies including Harvey, Anthropic and OpenAI, according to a report published on Thursday by legal analytics company Firm Prospects. SEYFARTH SUED AFTER DISCLOSING DATA SECURITY BREACH Law firm Seyfarth Shaw was sued on Thursday by a former employee of one of the law firm's clients who said a recently disclosed cybersecurity incident exposed sensitive personal information belonging to more than 56,000 people. The proposed class action was filed in federal court in Chicago shortly after the firm [USN:L6N45F0WX TEXT:"reported the breach"] to state regulators. The plaintiff is a former employee of AAA Mountain West Group, according to the lawsuit. The Chicago-founded firm in a statement on Thursday said "there was no malware and our network and systems were not breached." The firm said "someone impersonating our IT help desk targeted a single employee, and a limited number of documents were sent to an unauthorized email account." 3M ORDERED TO PAY $296,000 TO ILLINOIS' LAWYERS AT DICELLO LEVITT A federal judge in Illinois has ordered 3M to pay nearly $296,000 in legal fees to plaintiffs firm DiCello Levitt, which is representing the state on a contingency basis in a lawsuit alleging contamination from "forever chemicals." US District Judge Sara Darrow in the federal court in Rock Island, Illinois, ruled that the contingency-fee lawyers could recover fees for work related to 3M's unsuccessful effort to move the case from state to federal court. The judge awarded DiCello Levitt $295,933 for about 285 hours of work on the removal dispute. Darrow said courts within the 7th US Circuit Court of Appeals have allowed such awards, even though the appeals court has not directly addressed the issue. Illinois sued 3M in 2022 over alleged contamination of drinking water, soil and air. 3M has denied wrongdoing and has appealed the ruling sending the case back to Illinois state court. The company opposed the state's recovery of fees. 3M and the Illinois attorney general’s office did not immediately respond to requests for comment. On Billable Hour’s radar this week… -- In the era of AI, law firms are placing a greater [USN:L6N45D0YZ TEXT:"emphasis on relationship-building"] as a key competitive advantage, our columnist Sara Randazzo writes. -- Private equity-backed national accounting firm Sorren said it has launched an affiliated law firm, the latest example of [USN:L6N45E109 TEXT:"accounting firms expanding"] into legal services. -- Former star Supreme Court lawyer Tom Goldstein [USN:L6N44K00Z TEXT:"will remain in jail"] while he appeals his conviction in federal court for tax crimes and other fraud. Read More: [USN:L6N42308A TEXT:"AI error-ridden court filings surge despite three years of sanctions"] [USN:L6N450049 TEXT:"Legal profession is ‘detrimental’ to mental health, say 41% of lawyers"] [USN:L6N44S168 TEXT:"Rival lawyers clash over fees after $2.8 billion Blue Cross settlement"]

item.title: UBS株上昇、外銀との統合など検討報道－モルガン・スタンレーは下落
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： スイスの金融大手UBSグループの株価が24日に上昇する一方、米モルガン・スタンレーは下落した。スイス国内で資本規制が厳格化される可能性に直面する中、チューリヒに本拠を置くUBSが、他国・地域の銀行との取引を含む選択肢を検討しているとの報道を受けた。

セマフォーの報道によると、UBSはスイスの規制当局の監督下から抜ける方法を巡る協議を再開した。選択肢の1つとして、モルガン・スタンレーやドイツ銀行、スタンダードチャータードなどの外国銀行との統合が考えられると、同メディアは報じた。

今週これまでに、スイス議会上院の過半数が、同国最大の銀行であるUBSに自己資本の積み増しを義務付ける案を支持した。UBSは、この措置により普通株式等Tier1（CET1）資本を160億ドル（約2兆5400億円）追加で保有する必要があると試算している。

24日のニューヨーク市場で午後3時10分（日本時間25日午前4時10分）時点、モルガン・スタンレー株は1%下落し、ドイツ銀行株も0.6%安。スタンダードチャータード株は1%下落した。一方、UBS株は0.9%上昇。

UBS、ドイツ銀行、スタンダードチャータードの各行担当者からは、コメント要請に対する回答がすぐには得られなかった。モルガン・スタンレーの広報担当者はコメントを控えた。

原題：UBS Gains, Morgan Stanley Drops on Report Swiss Bank Eyeing Deal（抜粋）

item.title: 米とイラン、段階的な合意模索－ホルムズ再開と海上封鎖解除巡り
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国とイランの交渉担当者は、イランがホルムズ海峡の通航を再開し、米国がイランの港湾に対する海上封鎖を解除する方向で段階的な合意を模索している。協議に詳しい関係者が明らかにした。

両国はここ数カ月、同様の合意をいずれも拒んできたが、ニューヨークで開かれている国連総会に合わせて開かれた24日の協議で事態打開を目指している。関係者が匿名を条件に明らかにした。カタール当局者が交渉を仲介しているという。

段階的な合意は、米国とイランが6月半ばに締結した覚書と似た形になる見通しだ。ただ、この覚書を受けて不安定ながら成立した停戦は、わずか数週間後に崩壊した経緯がある。

ホワイトハウス当局者は、トランプ大統領はイランとの対話に引き続き前向きだとしつつ、米国は交渉する必要はないと強調した。制裁強化と海上封鎖がイラン経済に圧力をかけており、米国が有利な立場にあるためだと説明した。

米国とイランの断続的な交渉は、戦争開始以降、何度も決裂している。主な対立点はホルムズ海峡を巡る問題と、米国が凍結している数十億ドルの資金をイランがいつ利用できるようになるかだった。

国連総会出席のためニューヨークを訪れていたイランのペゼシュキアン大統領は演説で、制裁と米国による海上封鎖が続く限り、イランはホルムズ海峡での航行の自由を認めないと強調した。

イラン国営メディアによると、アラグチ外相がイラン側を代表して協議に臨み、ホルムズ海峡の通航再開を巡るイランの「確固たる立場」を説明。イラン側の報道によれば、条件には米国による海上封鎖の即時解除、イラン資産の凍結解除、「あらゆる戦線」での戦争終結が含まれる。「あらゆる戦線」での戦争終結とは、レバノンの親イラン・イスラム教シーア派組織ヒズボラに対してイスラエルが展開する軍事作戦を指しているとみられる。

ペゼシュキアン氏は24日夜に放送されたFOXニュースとのインタビューで、「われわれはホルムズ海峡を封鎖していない。法的な正当性も枠組みもないまま開かれていた。彼らがわれわれを攻撃した」と強調した。

item.title: Trump admin asks SC to allow quick third-country deportations to continue
item.description: The government asked for an immediate halt to lower court orders finding that people must have the chance to object before the US government deports them to countries other than their homelands ...
item.content:encoded:
Home / World News / Trump admin asks SC to allow quick third-country deportations to continue

Trump admin asks SC to allow quick third-country deportations to continue The government asked for an immediate halt to lower court orders finding that people must have the chance to object before the US government deports them to countries other than their homelands

The Trump administration has deported thousands of people under a series of agreements with nearly two dozen countries, including South Sudan, Equatorial Guinea and Panama | Image: Bloomberg

AP Washington 2 min read Last Updated : Sep 25 2026 | 8:12 AM IST

Listen to This Article

President Donald Trump's administration asked the Supreme Court on Thursday to again clear the way for continued quick deportations of immigrants to third countries where they have no ties. The government asked for an immediate halt to lower court orders finding that people must have the chance to object before the US government deports them to countries other than their homelands. The justices previously allowed the deportation flights to temporarily continue when the case came before them last year. Since then, an appeals court has upheld a Boston-based judge's final ruling that migrants must have a meaningful chance to argue a third-country deportation would put them in danger of persecution or torture.

The ruling didn't prohibit those deportations outright but it lengthens the process. The government argues it has already led to the cancellation of a flight carrying 70 people with criminal convictions to three different countries. "The government has been able to remove thousands of aliens to third countries in recent months, and thousands more are eligible for such removal," Solicitor General D John Sauer wrote. Also Read

Trump, Xi review ties, vow to chart future course over common interests

India drove Brics talks on cross-border payments: DEA Secretary Thakur

Trump welcomes Xi for US visit, hails their 'truly great friendship'

Judge orders Trump to restore White House access to CNN, MS NOW, Politico

Donald Trump welcomes Xi Jinping to Washington looking for a trade win

Trump's Republican administration has said that it sends people to third countries when it is unable to quickly return them to their homelands. Those third-country governments provide assurances that people won't be persecuted or tortured, attorneys said.

The lower courts' legal requirements would mean cascading delays and could force the reworking of agreements with foreign countries, attorneys wrote. The Trump administration has deported thousands of people under a series of agreements with nearly two dozen countries, including South Sudan, Equatorial Guinea and Panama. This month, lawyers for two men deported to Equatorial Guinea said they were beaten and held at gunpoint in a hotel-turned-detention center by police who covered their heads with bags. The case comes amid a sweeping immigration crackdown by the Trump administration, which has pledged to deport millions of people who are living in the United States illegally.

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

item.description: Nyrstar, owned by commodities group Trafigura, has launched a strategic review of its loss-making Budel zinc smelting operations in the Netherlands due to r
item.dc:creator: Mining.com
item.content:encoded: Nyrstar, owned by commodities group Trafigura, has launched a strategic review of its loss-making Budel zinc smelting operations in the Netherlands due to rising energy costs and government policies, it said on Thursday. Operations to produce the metal mainly used to galvanise steel will continue as normal during the review, which is expected to conclude by the end of 2026, Nyrstar added in a statement. “Nyrstar Budel faces significant pressure in terms of tough market conditions, elevated energy prices and historically low treatment and refining charges over a sustained period,” said CEO Guido Janssen. “The operation is losing money every year and the conditions for next year look particularly difficult, given rising energy costs, together with a lack of supportive government policy.” Adding to the pressure was a decision by the Dutch government not to include provisions for grid cost mitigation for energy-intensive industries in its 2027 budget, Nyrstar said. The Budel smelter, with a capacity to produce 315,000 metric tons per year of zinc, was suspended in the second half of January 2024 due to high energy costs and restarted in May of that year. “This is a significant decision point for Budel. The review will allow us to carefully assess the site’s position and the options available, while continuing to consider whether concrete action can materially improve the business case,” Janssen said. (Reporting by Eric Onstad; Editing by Susan Fenton)

item.description: Adds details in bullets 1-3 SAO PAULO, Sept 24 (Reuters) - MercadoLibre MELI.O launched product deliveries within an hour in Brazil, starting in the city of
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Adds details in bullets 1-3 SAO PAULO, Sept 24 (Reuters) - MercadoLibre MELI.O launched product deliveries within an hour in Brazil, starting in the city of Sao Paulo, Fernando Yunes, the firm's executive vice president of commerce, said on Thursday. The Latin American e-commerce and fintech company also will expand its pharmacy business in the country, with its own pharmacy in Sao Paulo beginning to sell prescription products this month, Yunes said at a company event. MercadoLibre will add third-party pharmacies to its e-commerce platform in Brazil as of October, kicking off in Sao Paulo with three drugstore chains, which were not named. The company expects to have 20 third-party physical drugstore locations in Sao Paulo on its platform by the end of the year. The one-hour service, which started as a test in an undisclosed region of Sao Paulo and is expected to be expanded, will include products such as medications, food and others. (Reporting by Andre Romani; Editing by Chris Reese and Cynthia Osterman) ((fernando.cardoso@thomsonreuters.com;))

item.title: 【欧州市況】株・債券とも続落、ドイツ債利回りは2日間で14bp上昇
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 24日の欧州債市場では、ドイツ10年債が2日間の取引として2カ月ぶりの大幅下落。石油・ガス価格が上げを拡大する中で、タームプレミアムが上昇した。

ドイツ10年債利回りは2日間で14ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）上昇。それでも、24日はドイツ債務管理庁が10－12月（第4四半期）の発行規模を昨年12月に発表した計画で据え置いたことから、スワップ金利に比べて堅調に推移している。

フランス債とドイツ債のスプレッドは1bp狭まって110bp、イタリア債とドイツ債のスプレッドは95bpで変わらなかった。

英国債も下落したが、ドイツ債や米国債に比べて下げ幅は小さかった。

イラン最高指導者の顧問が動画で、米国との紛争が次の段階ではインド洋にまで及ぶ可能性があると述べたことを受け、北海ブレント原油は一時4.4%上昇して1バレル＝108ドルを突破。これを受け、業種別の上昇率はエネルギー株が最も大きかった。

一方、米国債の下げ拡大を反映し、借り入れコスト増加への懸念からテクノロジー株が下落、指数を圧迫した。

item.title: 【米国市況】国債利回り上昇、30年債は2004年以来の高水準－159円台
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 24日の米金融市場では、米30年債利回りが3日連続で上昇し、2004年以来の高水準を付けた。インフレや政府債務への懸念を背景に、世界的な国債売りが続いている。

原油相場が上昇する中、米国債相場はこの日、比較的大きな値動きとなった。全ての年限で利回りが上昇。特に30年債利回りは一時10ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）上がり、約5.5%と2004年以来の高水準に達した。10年債利回りも一時10bp上昇して、5.22%と07年以来の高水準となった。

シット・インベストメント・アソシエーツの債券ファンドマネジャー、ブライス・ドティ氏は「これが過剰反応なのか、それとも利回りが再び上昇する動きの始まりなのか、市場関係者は見極めようとしている」と述べた。

米財務省はこの日、米国債買い戻し拡充を発表してから2回目となる買い戻しを実施したが、前日に発表した上限（60億ドル）には届かなかった。この結果が伝わった後、利回りは一段と上昇する場面があった。

ウェリントン・マネジメントのポートフォリオマネジャー、ブリジ・クラナ氏は、米国債が「ここ数日かなり売り込まれていたのに、上限の60億ドルまで買い戻さなかったことで、市場は驚かされた」と述べた。

「買い戻しの目的は、相場が急激に動いたり、市場の流動性が低下した際に対応することだと考えていた。昨日はまさにそうした日だったのではないか」と指摘。「こうした状況で上限まで買い戻さないのであれば、いつ買い戻すのかという疑問が生じる」と語った。

この日実施された7年債入札（440億ドル規模）は、最高落札利回りが5.085%と、2009年に7年債が再導入された後で最も高くなった。需要は予想を若干下回った。

根強いインフレや政府支出、またAI関連の設備投資を賄うための企業の借り入れ急増に対し、懸念が強まっている。こうした状況を背景に、債券保有者はより高い上乗せ利回りを要求している。

item.title: 円が一時159円台に下落、9月2日以来の安値－介入への警戒くすぶる
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）： 24日のニューヨーク外国為替市場で、円が対ドルで一時159円台に下落した。
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 24日のニューヨーク外国為替市場で、円が対ドルで一時159円台に下落した。 2週間にわたる円安で1ドル＝160円の節目が再び視野に入ったことで、為替介入リスクが改めて意識されている。

円は一時、0.5%安の1ドル＝159円04銭と、9月2日以来の安値に下げた。その後は158円台後半まで下げを縮小した。

この日は原油高を背景に、米国債利回りが全ての年限で上昇。特に30年債利回りは一時、約10ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）上がって約5.5%と、2004年以来の高水準に達した。

金利上昇を背景にドル買いの勢いが強まり、ブルームバーグ・ドル・スポット指数は5日続伸した。

バンク・オブ・ナッソー1982のチーフエコノミスト、ウィン・シン氏は「1ドル＝160円に近づくにつれて、当局による口先介入が強まるだろう。ドル・円相場が160円を超えれば、さらなる為替介入が行われる可能性もある」と述べた。

シティグループのストラテジスト、ダニエル・トボン氏は、「円が159円を超えて下落し始めれば、当局が動くリスクは高まる」と指摘。「そのため、市場参加者は159－160円を超える円安・ドル高水準での円ショート維持には消極的になるだろう」と話した。

item.title: Rio Tinto to expand metals trading beyond own output
item.description: Mining giant targets third-party deals and derivatives as CEO Simon Trott seeks more value from its global asset base.
item.dc:creator: Cecilia Jamasmie
item.content:encoded:
Rio Tinto to expand metals trading beyond own output

Cecilia Jamasmie | September 24, 2026 | 4:46 am Markets   Suppliers & Equipment   Top Companies   Asia   Australia   Europe   Aluminum   Copper   Iron Ore   Lithium

Rio Tinto produces alumina as a core intermediate step in its vertically integrated aluminum business. ( Image courtesy of Rio Tinto. )

Rio Tinto (ASX, LON: RIO) plans to expand its metals trading business into third-party material and derivatives as chief executive Simon Trott seeks to squeeze more value from the world’s second-largest miner.

The initiative, Bloomberg reported , would mark a shift for Rio Tinto, which has historically focused on marketing its own production and operates a much smaller trading business than Glencore (LON: GLEN).

Glencore’s extensive trading network was one attraction during unsuccessful takeover talks between the companies over the past two years.

Rio Tinto does not intend to replicate standalone commodity trading houses, but is considering a significant expansion of its existing commercial business under chief commercial officer Bold Baatar, according to Bloomberg .

The push could give Rio greater flexibility to profit from regional supply imbalances and spare capacity across its global operations while broadening a commercial business that remains modest compared with major commodity traders.

Trading opportunities

Rio Tinto is considering more third-party trading in markets where its existing assets could provide an advantage. That includes alumina, where the company has surpluses in some regions and shortages in others.

In North America, its Kennecott operations have spare copper smelting capacity, creating opportunities to handle additional material. Rio Tinto could also trade copper cathode and related products such as sulphuric acid.

The commercial team currently has about 20 traders and could add several more as the company expands the operation.

The strategy fits with Trott’s broader overhaul of Rio Tinto since he became CEO last year . He has laid out plans to simplify the company, sell assets, cut costs and improve returns.

Rio Tinto is also in talks with Dutch multinational Vitol Group over a potential freight and logistics joint venture, another move that could reshape how the miner handles its global supply chain.

item.title: SK Hynix Is Eyeing Intel’s (INTC) Ohio Site. Why Micron (MU) Should Pay Attention
item.description: SK Hynix is exploring something it has never done before: manufacturing memory chips in the United States. Reuters reported on September 16 that the Korean m...
item.dc:creator: Habib Ur Rehman
item.content:encoded:
SK Hynix Is Eyeing Intel’s (INTC) Ohio Site. Why Micron (MU) Should Pay Attention

Habib Ur Rehman Wed, September 23, 2026 at 12:33 AM EDT 3 min read

INTC -3.45%

SKHY +2.78%

MU +0.16%

Explore stocks on Coinbase Trading disclosure

Trading disclosure The above button links to Coinbase. Yahoo Finance is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser and does not offer securities or cryptocurrencies for sale or facilitate trading. Coinbase pays us for certain activity generated through this link. Prices displayed are informational. Learn more

SK Hynix is exploring something it has never done before: manufacturing memory chips in the United States. Reuters reported on September 16 that the Korean memory giant is discussing several possibilities with Intel Corporation (NASDAQ: INTC ), including leasing part of Intel's long-delayed Ohio complex or forming a venture involving Intel and large cloud customers. SK Hynix said no specific plan has been finalized. For Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MU ), the talks matter because one of its strongest strategic advantages is being the major U.S.-based memory producer while AI has made DRAM and HBM increasingly scarce.

SK Hynix May Move Into Intel’s $100 Billion Ohio Fab. Micron Has a Reason to Watch SK Hynix Could Give Intel Another Path for Its Delayed Ohio Site Intel has committed enormous capital to Ohio, with the broader project potentially reaching around $100 billion over time. Delays have pushed planned production into the next decade. A tenant or joint-venture partner could therefore help Intel share the financial burden of developing the Ohio site rather than relying entirely on its own foundry demand to justify the buildout.

That is the bull case. The bear case is that exploratory talks are a long way from revenue. Bringing advanced Korean memory production to the U.S. could face cost problems, technology-transfer restrictions and objections from Seoul. Intel still needs its core manufacturing roadmap to work. Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) sits on the other side of the equation. AI demand has pushed memory pricing and availability into a strong cycle, and Micron is already pursuing a large U.S. manufacturing expansion. More domestic manufacturing incentives and customer interest in secure supply support that plan. A successful SK Hynix move could eventually erode part of Micron's U.S.-supply differentiation. U.S. cloud companies would gain another potential domestic supplier, while additional long-term memory capacity could eventually loosen the market that currently supports exceptional pricing. Hedge funds loaded up on both chipmakers Insider Monkey tracked 138 hedge funds holding Intel in Q2, up sharply from 112 in Q1. AQR Capital Management held roughly 10.7 million shares after trimming its stake about 7%. Micron's count rose to 184 funds from 154, one of the stronger quarter-over-quarter increases among large semiconductor names. Coatue Management expanded its MU stake dramatically during the quarter.

Intel had about 152.2 million shares sold short as of August 31, roughly 3% of public float and 1.7 days to cover. The talks do not rescue Intel's foundry strategy or weaken Micron overnight. They do show what AI scarcity is doing to the supply chain. Memory manufacturing is becoming strategic enough that SK Hynix is considering putting advanced capacity on American soil, and Intel's delayed Ohio project suddenly gives it a potentially valuable asset to negotiate with.

Story Continues While we acknowledge the potential of INTC and MU as investments, we believe certain other AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. item.title: Europe’s Solar Boom Has a Storage Problem
item.description: Solar has become Europe’s largest source of power during summer months, helped by government incentives, falling technology costs and a rapid buildout across rooftops and utility-scale projects. But that success is creating a new problem: on sunny days, Europe can produce more solar power than the system can absorb, pushing wholesale electricity prices to zero or below and leaving some renewable generators suffering from their own success. Industry experts say the answer is not less solar, but more storage, more flexible demand and stronger grids that can move power from where it is generated to where it is needed. (Source: Bloomberg)

Platinum Futures.PL1! **Platinum Futures** continues to present a constructive technical outlook, with the broader market structure favoring the upside. No specific entry level has been identified in this setup; instead, the focus is on the lower timeframe, where early signs of renewed buyer participation are beginning to appear. If this momentum develops into a confirmed bullish structure, the current phase could provide an opportunity to participate in the continuation of the broader trend.

**Key technical observations:**

• The lower timeframe is already showing signs of increasing buyer participation and improving demand. • The development of **Higher Highs (HH)** and **Higher Lows (HL)** would provide stronger confirmation of bullish market structure. • A constructive shift in the moving averages would further support the transition toward sustained upside momentum. • The absence of a predefined entry level makes confirmation of buyer control particularly important before considering participation in the next potential rally.

Technical analysis provides a useful framework for identifying momentum and market structure, while the broader outlook for platinum should also be considered through supply-demand dynamics, industrial demand, investment flows, and macroeconomic conditions. Combining these factors with valuation and risk assessment can provide a more complete investment perspective.

Precious metals can experience substantial volatility even within established bullish trends. Maintaining patience, waiting for objective confirmation from market structure, and applying disciplined risk management can help investors participate in a developing move without reacting prematurely to short-term fluctuations.

This publication reflects a personal interpretation of market structure and publicly available information. It is intended solely for educational and informational purposes and should not be considered financial advice or a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold any financial instrument. Independent research, prudent risk management, and personal due diligence should always precede any investment decision.
